title: 贾克斯·亮彩手绘 Sketch
description: 紫色兜帽叠着层层长袍，金属面具上保留数个细小发光眼孔。

art_direction.medium: bright colored-pencil sketch, confident graphite contours, visible cross-hatching and selective gouache on pale drawing paper
art_direction.identity: Jax is a broad mysterious humanoid with a purple hooded coat, layered robes, gloves, boots, and a metal face mask bearing several small luminous eye apertures. Preserve the concealed face and distinctive clustered lights without inventing a visible ordinary human identity. His full body remains covered, and the long lamp-post staff stands planted beside him, its lantern steady rather than swung as a weapon.
art_direction.scene: An eye-level three-quarter turn, face off center, a sweeping contour linking the head to the defining motif in open pale paper. Build the composition around this champion's defining anatomy and core motif. Only a few light environment marks; keep the picture predominantly bright and colorful.
art_direction.palette: purple, warm brass, amber lamp, clear sky blue; high-value vivid local color, luminous warm-white paper, bright chromatic shadows, limited canonical dark details
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: Compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280 and under 350 KB
